import os,stat,pathlib,json,hashlib,signal
signal.alarm(20)
assert os.getuid()==os.geteuid()==1000
boot=pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()
assert boot=='55c386b9-fe6d-4388-a7f4-1d91e0bb49d8'
flags=os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC
fds=[os.open('/',flags)]
try:
 for part in ('home','arduino','sumox26_codex_build'):
  before=os.stat(part,dir_fd=fds[-1],follow_symlinks=False)
  assert stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode)
  if part!='home': assert before.st_uid==1000
  child=os.open(part,flags,dir_fd=fds[-1]); fds.append(child)
  after=os.fstat(child); assert (after.st_dev,after.st_ino,after.st_mode,after.st_uid)==(before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_mode,before.st_uid)
 os.mkdir('cleanup-app-inert-root02',mode=0o700,dir_fd=fds[-1])
 child=os.open('cleanup-app-inert-root02',flags,dir_fd=fds[-1]);fds.append(child)
 info=os.fstat(child);assert info.st_uid==1000 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700 and os.listdir(child)==[]
 print(json.dumps({'status':'EXCLUSIVE_EMPTY_STAGE_CREATED','boot_id':boot,'dev':info.st_dev,'ino':info.st_ino}))
finally:
 for fd in reversed(fds):os.close(fd)

flags=os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC
fds=[os.open('/',flags)]
try:

  before=os.stat(part,dir_fd=fds[-1],follow_symlinks=False)
  assert stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode)
  if part!='home': assert before.st_uid==1000
  child=os.open(part,flags,dir_fd=fds[-1]); fds.append(child)
  after=os.fstat(child); assert (after.st_dev,after.st_ino,after.st_mode,after.st_uid)==(before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_mode,before.st_uid)
 pins={'cleanup_root02.py': {'bytes': 9592, 'sha256': '4192f23ea49705a0af691953e6aec3c1f9da66c7cc1897ca3f5d49fba9fc5388'}, 'cleanup_remoteocd01.py': {'bytes': 7873, 'sha256': '23ef85ae3c386cc76751eea0fb18a90148a6fe513e3e8c753d527c06efcbbe95'}, 'static_remote.py': {'bytes': 33321, 'sha256': '8ba9b190c38e728013a383348c60c287b0366607f65f703161cf7f2e142d36f8'}}
 child=os.open('cleanup-app-inert-root02',flags,dir_fd=fds[-1]);fds.append(child)
 info=os.fstat(child);assert info.st_uid==1000 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o700 and set(os.listdir(child))==set(pins)
 observed={}
 for name,pin in pins.items():
  before=os.stat(name,dir_fd=child,follow_symlinks=False)
  assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid==before.st_gid==1000 and before.st_nlink==1 and before.st_size==pin['bytes']
  fd=os.open(name,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,dir_fd=child)
  try:
   opened=os.fstat(fd);assert (opened.st_dev,opened.st_ino,opened.st_size)==(before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_size)
   data=b''
   while len(data)<=pin['bytes']:
    chunk=os.read(fd,pin['bytes']+1-len(data))
    if not chunk:break
    data+=chunk
   digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest();assert len(data)==pin['bytes'] and digest==pin['sha256']
   after=os.fstat(fd);current=os.stat(name,dir_fd=child,follow_symlinks=False)
   def stamp(s):return (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_uid,s.st_gid,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)
   assert stamp(before)==stamp(after)==stamp(current)
   observed[name]={'bytes':len(data),'sha256':digest,'uid':before.st_uid,'gid':before.st_gid,'nlink':before.st_nlink}
  finally:os.close(fd)
 print(json.dumps({'status':'STAGED_FILES_VERIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED','boot_id':boot,'dev':info.st_dev,'ino':info.st_ino,'files':observed,'scratch_exists':pathlib.Path('/tmp/remoteocd').exists()}))
finally:
 for fd in reversed(fds):os.close(fd)
